title: Half-Life 3 Strings Found in Deadlock!
content: Dataminers have discovered brand new references to 'HLX' (Half-Life 3) embedded inside the Source 2 renderer files from the latest Deadlock game update.

title: Steam Frame OLED 'Plano' Leak
content: Linux kernel source code leaks reveal Valve is actively developing 'Steam Frame OLED' (codenamed Plano), featuring massive 3.5K x 3.8K MicroOLED displays per eye.
